newsitem.title: UK: Firm dollar subdues European meals market.
newsitem.headline: Firm dollar subdues European meals market.

text.p: The firm dollar against most European currencies was the main feature of the meals market on Wednesday morning.
"The dollar is making it very difficult and people are only interested in nearby material when they do trade," said one trader.
South American soymeal opened mixed with nearby months $1.00 down while forwards were $2.00 higher.
Sunmeal started unchanged to $2 higher while corngulten feed pellets were mixed at $1.00 down to $1.50 up.
Citrus pulp pellets were lower with opening offers $2.00 to $3.00 down while rapemeal ex-mill lower Rhine was little changed.
